raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. building where criminals are kept, penjara, jel: several convicts broke out of the ~, beberapa orang banduan lari dr penjara; 2. ( derog ) place perceived as such, seolah-olah penjara: he longed to escaped from the ~ of the factory, dia ingin melarikan diri dr kilang yg seolah-olah penjara itu; 3. situation in which one feels trapped, penjara: she was trapped in a ~ fears and fantasies, dia terperangkap dlm penjara ketakutan dan khayalan. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
